{{Quote|Senator Drexx must have considerable wealth to stage an event this large.''"<br />"''A little ''too'' much wealth, perhaps. I have long suspected him of taking bribes from the Separatists, but I have no proof. I want everyone to keep their eyes open. If we can get some hard evidence, we ''may'' be able to bring him to justice.|Padmé Amidala and Bail Prestor Organa|<ref name="Spy Girls" />}}
Suspecting that [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bezz Drexx]] was taking bribes from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],
Senators [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], as well as the former's [[Senatorial aide|aide]] [[Sheltay Retrac/Legends|Sheltay Retrac]] and the latter's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], attended a party hosted by Drexx in [[Bezz Drexx's tower|his tower]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In truth, however, they had come to Drexx's event in order to '''infiltrate''' his tower and uncover evidence to support their theory. Amidala and Retrac ventured further into the tower on their own, eventually discovering the proof they sought in the form of [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente's]] [[Passel Argente's uncle|uncle]] supplying Drexx with a case full of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in exchange for his continued loyalty to the Separatists.<ref name="Spy Girls" />
